common_factorial_design.initial_condition_policy: depth-wise within-season median assigned to every retained treatment

protein_policy: not mixed into primary SA; implement and verify SPE injection before a separate secondary screen
environment_policy: SOIL and FileX initial conditions fixed in primary genetic SA
simulation_options_policy: SYMBI=N and POTAS=N for non-legume eggplant using CRGRO048

analysis.screening: Morris with three fixed seeds and ten trajectories per seed initially
analysis.extension: add trajectories only if ranking stability is inadequate
analysis.sobol: not automatic; consider only for a reduced influential subset
analysis.aggregation: season-specific QA first, then equal-season standardized-effect aggregation

remaining_gates: commit the reviewed source, frozen bounds, input bundles and output contracts in a clean worktree
the revised XXQL2601 seven-treatment bundle passes deterministic DSSAT baseline smoke
build one frozen-runtime case and verify its runtime manifest before launching the r=10 campaign
